    if not cmd_parts:

    cmd_filepath = which(cmd)
    if not cmd_filepath:
        return False
    # Resolves symlinks and produces a normalized absolute path string.

        f.write(text.encode(encoding))
    try:
        subprocess.call([str(cmd_path), filename])
    except OSError:
        # Command not found
        pass
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
        os.unlink(filename)

    return True
